Components.Description: Position, rotation and scale relative to the parent entity
Components.Name: Transform

Properties.Name: Rotation
Properties.Tooltip: Edited as Euler angles in degrees

Components.Description: Gameplay label used to find groups of entities
Components.Name: Tag

Components.Description: Deactivates the entity and its descendants
Components.Name: Inactive

Components.Description: Links this entity to the prefab it was created from
Components.Name: PrefabInstance

Properties.Name: PerspectiveFOV
Properties.Tooltip: Vertical field of view in degrees

Properties.Name: OrthographicSize
Properties.Tooltip: Vertical extent in world units

Properties.Name: Primary
Properties.Tooltip: The first active primary camera renders the game view

Properties.Name: DepthOfField
Properties.Tooltip: Blurs what lies nearer or farther than the focus, as a camera's lens does (perspective cameras); players can turn it off

Properties.Name: FocusDistance
Properties.Tooltip: Meters from the camera to the sharpest plane

Properties.Name: FocusEntity
Properties.Tooltip: Keeps this entity in focus (its distance along the camera's view, at least the near plane); none: Focus Distance

Properties.Name: Aperture
Properties.Tooltip: The lens's f-number: lower blurs more (f/1.4 a portrait lens wide open), higher keeps more in focus (f/16)

Properties.Name: SensorHeight
Properties.Tooltip: Millimeters: with the field of view it sets the focal length; larger sensors blur more at the same view (24 full frame, 15.6 APS-C, 8.8 a 1-inch sensor)

Properties.Name: Material
Properties.Tooltip: Overrides every submesh material when set

Components.Description: Sun-like light shining along the entity's forward (-Z) direction; its intensity is illuminance in lux
Components.Name: DirectionalLight

Properties.Name: Color
Properties.Tooltip: Linear color of the light, times Intensity: (1, 1, 1) for the midday sun; the physical atmosphere dims and reddens it toward the horizon itself, so tint it only for a look

Properties.Name: Intensity
Properties.Tooltip: Illuminance in lux on a surface facing the light, times Color: direct sun about 100,000, an overcast day 1,000 to 10,000, a full moon 0.25

Properties.Name: ShadowSoftness
Properties.Tooltip: Angular diameter of the light's disk in degrees (the sun: about 0.53; an overcast sky's soft sun up to 10): its shadows' penumbra widens with the distance from the caster, and its highlight on smooth surfaces takes the disk's size. 0: the hardest shadow the filter allows and a point-like highlight

Properties.Name: CastShadows
Properties.Tooltip: Whether the light casts shadows: cascaded shadow maps out to Shadow Distance, their resolution and number set by Project Settings > Graphics Quality

Properties.Name: ShadowDistance
Properties.Tooltip: Meters from the camera the shadows reach; the last cascade fades out before it. Shorter spends the same shadow-map texels on less ground: sharper near shadows

Properties.Name: ShadowBias
Properties.Tooltip: Depth offset toward the light in shadow-map texels: raise it against shadow acne (stripes on lit surfaces), lower it when shadows detach from their casters

Properties.Name: ShadowNormalBias
Properties.Tooltip: Offset of the lookup along the surface normal in shadow-map texels: raise it against acne on surfaces at grazing angles to the light

Properties.Name: CascadeBlend
Properties.Tooltip: Fraction of each shadow cascade's depth range over which it blends into the next one, hiding the seams between them; the last one fades out by the Shadow Distance. 0 switches at once

Properties.Name: ContactShadowLength
Properties.Tooltip: Meters toward the light over which contact shadows ground objects smaller than the shadow cascades' texels, when Graphics Quality's Contact Shadows has steps (Custom; no preset draws them); 0 off

Properties.Name: CascadeDistribution
Properties.Tooltip: How the cascades share the distance from the nearest to the farthest surface the camera sees: 0 evenly, 1 each cascade the same ratio farther than the previous. Higher puts more detail near the camera

Components.Description: Light shining in every direction from the entity's position, with shadows in six directions when it casts them; its intensity is luminous intensity in candela
Components.Name: PointLight

Properties.Name: Intensity
Properties.Tooltip: Luminous intensity in candela, times Color, falling off with the square of the distance: a bulb of P lumens has P / 12.57 cd (800 lm, about 64 cd), a candle about 1

Properties.Name: Range
Properties.Tooltip: Light fades to zero at this distance

Properties.Name: SourceRadius
Properties.Tooltip: Radius in meters of the light's bulb or flame: smooth and wet surfaces show its highlight at that size, the same light spread wider (a lantern about 0.05, a fire about 0.25). Its diffuse light and shadows do not change. 0: a point

Properties.Name: CastShadows
Properties.Tooltip: Casts shadows: the renderer gives the most relevant shadowed lights in view (16) tiles of its shadow atlas, six for a point light, one for a spot light; each costs drawing its casters again when they move

Properties.Name: ShadowBias
Properties.Tooltip: Depth offset toward the light, in texels of the light's shadow tiles: raise it if lit surfaces show stripes of shadow (acne)

Properties.Name: ShadowNormalBias
Properties.Tooltip: Offset along the surface normal, in texels of the light's shadow tiles: raise it against acne on surfaces lit at grazing angles; too much detaches shadows from their casters

Properties.Name: ShadowFilterRadius
Properties.Tooltip: Radius of the shadow's soft edge, in texels of the light's shadow tiles (0 to 8)

Components.Description: Cone light shining along the entity's forward (-Z) direction, with shadows when it casts them; its intensity is luminous intensity in candela along its axis
Components.Name: SpotLight

Properties.Name: Intensity
Properties.Tooltip: Luminous intensity in candela along the axis, times Color, falling off with the square of the distance; a narrower cone does not make it brighter

Properties.Name: SourceRadius
Properties.Tooltip: Radius in meters of the light's bulb or flame: smooth and wet surfaces show its highlight at that size, the same light spread wider (a lantern about 0.05, a fire about 0.25). Its diffuse light and shadows do not change. 0: a point

Properties.Name: InnerConeAngle
Properties.Tooltip: Half angle in degrees

Properties.Name: OuterConeAngle
Properties.Tooltip: Half angle in degrees

Properties.Name: CastShadows
Properties.Tooltip: Casts shadows: the renderer gives the most relevant shadowed lights in view (16) tiles of its shadow atlas, six for a point light, one for a spot light; each costs drawing its casters again when they move

Properties.Name: ShadowBias
Properties.Tooltip: Depth offset toward the light, in texels of the light's shadow tiles: raise it if lit surfaces show stripes of shadow (acne)

Properties.Name: ShadowNormalBias
Properties.Tooltip: Offset along the surface normal, in texels of the light's shadow tiles: raise it against acne on surfaces lit at grazing angles; too much detaches shadows from their casters

Properties.Name: ShadowFilterRadius
Properties.Tooltip: Radius of the shadow's soft edge, in texels of the light's shadow tiles (0 to 8)

Components.Description: Image-based lighting and sky background from an HDR environment map, a procedural sky or a physical atmosphere lit by the directional light; its radiance is luminance in nits (cd/m²) times its intensity (the atmosphere's: per lux of the light's illuminance)
Components.Name: SkyLight

Properties.Name: Source
Properties.Tooltip: EnvironmentMap: an HDR texture; Procedural: a sky computed from the colors below and the directional light; Atmosphere: Earth's sky lit by the directional light, which it dims and reddens toward the horizon

Properties.Name: EnvironmentMap
Properties.Tooltip: Equirectangular HDR texture

Properties.Name: Intensity
Properties.Tooltip: Multiplies the sky's luminance in nits (cd/m²): an environment map's values, the procedural colors, the ambient color, and the atmosphere's sky (nits per lux of the directional light)

Properties.Name: Rotation
Properties.Tooltip: Degrees around +Y (environment maps only)

Properties.Name: AmbientColor
Properties.Tooltip: Ambient sky luminance in nits (linear, times Intensity) while there is no environment (no map set)

Properties.Name: ZenithColor
Properties.Tooltip: Procedural sky: luminance straight up in nits (linear, times Intensity)

Properties.Name: HorizonColor
Properties.Tooltip: Procedural sky: luminance at the horizon in nits (linear, times Intensity)

Properties.Name: GroundColor
Properties.Tooltip: Procedural sky: luminance below the horizon in nits (linear, times Intensity)

Properties.Name: SunSize
Properties.Tooltip: Procedural sky and atmosphere: angular diameter of the sun's disk in degrees (0 hides it)

Properties.Name: SunIntensity
Properties.Tooltip: Procedural sky: luminance of the sun's disk in nits, times the directional light's color (not its intensity) and this sky's Intensity

Properties.Name: AtmosphereDensity
Properties.Tooltip: Atmosphere: density of its air and aerosols (1: Earth's); thicker air reddens the sun sooner

Properties.Name: AtmosphereHaze
Properties.Tooltip: Atmosphere: amount of aerosols (1: a clear day), the whitish haze and glow around the sun

Properties.Name: GroundAlbedo
Properties.Tooltip: Atmosphere: diffuse reflectance of the planet's ground, which lights the sky from below

Properties.Name: AerialPerspective
Properties.Tooltip: Atmosphere: distant surfaces fade into the air's haze, as the sky does (aerial perspective)

Properties.Name: AerialPerspectiveScale
Properties.Tooltip: Atmosphere: distances multiplied by this for the haze: 1 is Earth's air, 4 makes a 1 km view look like 4 km

Components.Description: Fog that thickens toward the ground, over the scene's surfaces and its sky (the first active one applies)
Components.Name: HeightFog

Properties.Name: Density
Properties.Tooltip: Extinction per meter at the base height: 0.02 hides half of what lies 35 m away

Properties.Name: HeightFalloff
Properties.Tooltip: Per meter: the density falls by the factor e every 1 / falloff meters above the base height and rises below it

Properties.Name: BaseHeight
Properties.Tooltip: World height in meters where the density is Density

Properties.Name: StartDistance
Properties.Tooltip: Meters from the camera before which there is no fog

Properties.Name: MaxOpacity
Properties.Tooltip: The most the fog hides of what lies behind it; the sky at the horizon gets this much

Properties.Name: Color
Properties.Tooltip: Linear albedo: the fraction of its light the fog scatters toward the viewer

Properties.Name: ColorFromSky
Properties.Tooltip: The sky lights the fog: the procedural sky's horizon color, an environment map's light from above, or the ambient color without either; off, Color is the fog's own radiance. The directional light lights it either way

Properties.Name: SunScattering
Properties.Tooltip: How strongly the fog scatters the directional light toward a viewer looking at it: 0 equally in every direction, 1 into a glow around the light

Components.Description: Reflections and ambient light inside a box from a capture of the scene around the entity (lighting.bakeProbes renders it); where boxes overlap the two strongest blend
Components.Name: ReflectionProbe

Properties.Name: Capture
Properties.Tooltip: Equirectangular HDR texture of the scene seen from the probe (luminance in nits): Bake writes one

Properties.Name: Extents
Properties.Tooltip: Half size of the influence box in meters, along the entity's axes (times its scale)

Properties.Name: BlendDistance
Properties.Tooltip: Meters inside the box's faces over which the probe fades into the sky's lighting (or a weaker probe's)

Properties.Name: BoxProjection
Properties.Tooltip: Reflections are projected onto the box's faces, so walls near the box's faces reflect where they are (rooms); off, the capture is seen as if infinitely far (open spaces)

Properties.Name: Intensity
Properties.Tooltip: Multiplies the capture's luminance

Properties.Name: Priority
Properties.Tooltip: Where boxes overlap the higher priority wins (then the smaller box); with more probes in view than the renderer keeps, the strongest stay

Components.Description: Tonemapping, exposure, bloom, ambient occlusion, anti-aliasing and screen-space reflection settings
Components.Name: PostProcess

Properties.Name: Tonemapper
Properties.Tooltip: Filmic: the engine's camera-like curve, middle gray shown as middle gray, a soft shoulder that takes bright colors to white without changing their hue (Toe and Shoulder shape it); ACES: punchier, darker mid-tones (needs about +0.8 EV for the same brightness); AgX: flatter and less saturated; Khronos Neutral: keeps base colors up to the highlights; Reinhard; None: the exposed colors clipped

Properties.Name: Exposure
Properties.Tooltip: Exposure compensation in EV

Properties.Name: AutoExposure
Properties.Tooltip: Adapts the exposure to the scene's brightness over time, as an eye or a camera's meter does, within Auto Exposure Min and Max EV; off, Exposure alone sets it

Properties.Name: AutoExposureMinEV
Properties.Tooltip: Darkest average scene luminance (log2) automatic exposure brightens up to

Properties.Name: AutoExposureMaxEV
Properties.Tooltip: Brightest average scene luminance (log2) automatic exposure darkens down to

Properties.Name: AutoExposureSpeed
Properties.Tooltip: How fast the exposure follows a darker scene (the image brightens), per second; 0 jumps at once

Properties.Name: Bloom
Properties.Tooltip: A soft glow around bright light: the light a camera's lens scatters

Properties.Name: BloomIntensity
Properties.Tooltip: Fraction of the light scattered into the glow

Properties.Name: BloomThreshold
Properties.Tooltip: Only light brighter than this (after exposure) blooms; 0 = all light, physically based

Properties.Name: AmbientOcclusion
Properties.Tooltip: Darkens creases, corners and contacts that ambient light reaches less (screen-space ambient occlusion)

Properties.Name: AmbientOcclusionRadius
Properties.Tooltip: Meters: how far around a surface occluders darken it; on screen kept between 0.3% and 12% of the view's height

Properties.Name: AmbientOcclusionIntensity
Properties.Tooltip: How strongly the occlusion darkens ambient light: 1 as measured, 0 none, above 1 stronger

Properties.Name: AmbientOcclusionMultiBounce
Properties.Tooltip: Occluded corners of bright surfaces keep the light their walls reflect into them: white plaster stays light in its creases, dark soil darkens fully

Properties.Name: AntiAliasing
Properties.Tooltip: Smooths jagged edges, by the method below

Properties.Name: AntiAliasingMethod
Properties.Tooltip: FXAA: fast approximate anti-aliasing of each frame; TAA: temporal anti-aliasing, each frame sampled at another sub-pixel offset and blended with the earlier ones along their motion: smoother, steadier edges and thin details, and point and spot lights' soft shadow edges without their grain (the sun's are the same with any method). TAA Preset chooses how the TAA looks. Morphological: non-temporal, finds edges and blends along them, keeping texture detail

Properties.Name: TAAPreset
Properties.Tooltip: How the TAA looks. Sharp: tighter history clipping, slow pans resampled less, uncovered surfaces drop their history, transparent surfaces take mostly the current frame, a faster response to motion and a light sharpening of the displayed image. Original: the first TAA, softer and steadier. Custom: the tunables below (choosing it in the Inspector starts from the look in effect)

Properties.Name: TAAHistoryFrames
Properties.Tooltip: About how many frames the image averages: the current frame weighs at least 1 / this. At 8, every jitter position counts once. More is smoother and steadier but lags behind lighting changes; fewer reacts faster but edges crawl

Properties.Name: TAAMotionResponse
Properties.Tooltip: How quickly moving surfaces let go of the history. At 0.0625, motion of 8 pixels a frame weighs the current frame 0.5. Higher keeps moving things crisper and their trails shorter, but they get less anti-aliasing while they move. 0: motion does not matter

Properties.Name: TAAMaxMotionWeight
Properties.Tooltip: The most the current frame weighs, however fast things move. 1 lets very fast motion drop the history: sharp, but aliased

Properties.Name: TAAResampleWeight
Properties.Tooltip: The current frame's least weight where the history is read between pixels, as in slow pans; it is largest halfway between them. Higher keeps slowly moving texture crisper, but its edges get less anti-aliasing while they move. 0: off

Properties.Name: TAAHistoryClamp
Properties.Tooltip: How the history is kept consistent with what the pixel shows now. Range limits it to the range of the colors around the pixel. Tight limits it to a narrower box around their average, which removes more ghosting and trails, most where the surroundings are smooth and less beside glints

Properties.Name: TAAClipWidth
Properties.Tooltip: Tight only: the box's half width, in standard deviations of the colors around the pixel. Lower removes more trails, but lets edges flicker and lets noise through

Properties.Name: TAATransparentWeight
Properties.Tooltip: The current frame's least weight where a blended transparent surface covers the pixel (half cover or more counts as full). Transparent surfaces have no motion vectors of their own. 0 treats them like everything else, so they ghost when they move; 1 drops their history, so they never ghost, but their edges shimmer

Properties.Name: TAADisocclusionRejection
Properties.Tooltip: Drop the history where a surface was just uncovered (something nearer covered it in the previous frame), so moving objects leave no ghost on what they uncover

Properties.Name: TAADisocclusionThreshold
Properties.Tooltip: How much nearer the previous frame's surface must have been, as a fraction of the distance, for the pixel to count as uncovered. Lower catches thin gaps, such as a hand in front of a wall, but may drop the history of surfaces moving fast away from the camera

Properties.Name: TAASharpening
Properties.Tooltip: Sharpens the displayed image after TAA, never the history, to restore texture detail the averaging softens. Strong edges are sharpened much less and overshoot is bounded, so halos stay faint. 0 is off

Properties.Name: ScreenSpaceReflections
Properties.Tooltip: Reflections of what the screen shows, found each frame: smooth floors, water and metal reflect what stands near them. At Graphics Quality Medium (Reflections Checkerboard) only with TAA; High and Ultra trace every pixel with or without it. Where they find nothing (off screen, hidden, the sky) the reflection probes and the sky reflect as before

Properties.Name: ScreenSpaceReflectionsIntensity
Properties.Tooltip: How much the screen-space reflections replace the probes' and the sky's reflection where they find something; 1: fully

Properties.Name: ScreenSpaceReflectionsMaxRoughness
Properties.Tooltip: Surfaces rougher than this get none, and they fade out over the last quarter below it: rough surfaces blur what they reflect, which screen-space reflections do not

Properties.Name: Vignette
Properties.Tooltip: Natural darkening toward the image's corners, as a lens's (cos^4 of the field angle): 0 none, 1 a lens's full fall-off; 0.12 darkens the corners of a 60 degree view by about 10%

Properties.Name: Saturation
Properties.Tooltip: Color saturation after the tone curve: 1 unchanged, 0 gray, 2 twice as vivid

Properties.Name: Contrast
Properties.Tooltip: Around middle gray; 1 = unchanged

Properties.Name: Toe
Properties.Tooltip: How deep the shadows go: higher crushes the darkest tones toward black, lower keeps more detail in them (Filmic only)

Properties.Name: Shoulder
Properties.Tooltip: How softly highlights roll off to white: higher reaches white more stops above middle gray (5 at 0, 6.5 at 0.5, 8 at 1), keeping more highlight detail (Filmic only)

Properties.Name: WhiteBalanceTemperature
Properties.Tooltip: Temperature in kelvin of the light that shows as white: lower values cool the image (3200 for tungsten light), higher warm it; 6500 is neutral

Properties.Name: WhiteBalanceTint
Properties.Tooltip: Tint: positive adds magenta, negative green

Properties.Name: ColorSlope
Properties.Tooltip: Slope: per-channel gain before the tone curve

Properties.Name: ColorOffset
Properties.Tooltip: Offset: light added per channel, in fractions of middle gray (tints the shadows most)

Properties.Name: ColorPower
Properties.Tooltip: Power: per-channel contrast around middle gray

Properties.Name: AutoExposureMetering
Properties.Tooltip: How the image is metered: Average weighs every pixel alike; CenterWeighted counts the middle of the image most and its edges a quarter, as a camera's center-weighted meter

Properties.Name: AutoExposureLowPercentile
Properties.Tooltip: The darkest share of the metered pixels that is ignored, so deep shadows do not move the exposure

Properties.Name: AutoExposureHighPercentile
Properties.Tooltip: The brightest share of the metered pixels below this is kept: the pixels above it (light sources) do not move the exposure

Properties.Name: AutoExposureLightSpeed
Properties.Tooltip: How fast it follows a brighter scene (the image darkens), per second, as eyes leaving a tunnel; 0 jumps at once

Properties.Name: AutoExposureKey
Properties.Tooltip: How much a scene's brightness against a gray card in the sun shows: 0 meters every scene to middle gray; 0.12 shows an interior 5 stops below the sun's card 0.6 stops darker (at most 2); scenes above the card are not brightened. Needs a directional light

Properties.Name: BloomRadius
Properties.Tooltip: How far the glow reaches, as a fraction of the image height: the same share of the image at every resolution

Properties.Name: MotionBlur
Properties.Tooltip: Blurs what moves on screen over the shutter's share of each frame, as a film camera does; editor views never blur, and players can turn it off

Properties.Name: MotionBlurShutterAngle
Properties.Tooltip: How long the shutter stays open, in degrees of the frame: 180 blurs over half a frame's motion, as film cameras do; 0 none

Properties.Name: MotionBlurMaxLength
Properties.Tooltip: The longest blur, as a fraction of the image height: 0.02 is 43 pixels at 2160 rows

Properties.Name: FilmGrain
Properties.Tooltip: Film's grain, new every frame, most visible in the mid-tones; 1 spreads them by about 10 codes. Players can turn it off

Properties.Name: ChromaticAberration
Properties.Tooltip: A lens's lateral color fringes, red and blue drawn apart toward the corners; 1 shifts each half a pixel at a 3840x2160 image's corners. Players can turn it off

Properties.Name: ColorLookup
Properties.Tooltip: A grade made in another tool (a .cube file's 3D lookup table), applied to the finished image after the tone curve and the saturation. Nothing applies while it loads

Properties.Name: ColorLookupIntensity
Properties.Tooltip: How much of the color lookup's grade shows: 1 all of it, 0.5 halfway between the image and the graded image

Properties.Name: LensFlare
Properties.Tooltip: A lens's flares around very bright light, with restraint: faint tinted ghosts mirrored through the image's center, a halo, and six rays around the sun's disk while it is in view and not covered. 0 none

Components.Description: Text drawn in screen space (HUD) or in the world
Components.Name: Text

Properties.Name: ScreenAnchor
Properties.Tooltip: Normalized viewport position; (0,0) is the top-left corner

Properties.Name: ScreenOffset
Properties.Tooltip: Pixel offset from the anchor (+Y down)

Properties.Name: IsTrigger
Properties.Tooltip: Reports overlaps without colliding

Properties.Name: ContinuousCollision
Properties.Tooltip: Also swept against kinematic and dynamic bodies, for bullets (every dynamic body is swept against static ones anyway)

Properties.Name: Layer
Properties.Tooltip: Collision layer: it collides with the layers the project's layer matrix lets it

Properties.Name: Mesh
Properties.Tooltip: Uses the Mesh Renderer's mesh when unset

Properties.Name: Convex
Properties.Tooltip: Non-convex meshes are only supported on static bodies

Components.Description: An upright capsule that scripts walk, jump and teleport: it slides along walls, walks up steps and walkable slopes and pushes dynamic bodies; its bottom is the entity's origin
Components.Name: CharacterController

Properties.Name: Height
Properties.Tooltip: Total height of the capsule in world units; its bottom is the entity's origin

Properties.Name: Radius
Properties.Tooltip: World units

Properties.Name: StepHeight
Properties.Tooltip: Highest step it walks up, and how far it follows the ground down (world units)

Properties.Name: MaxSlopeDegrees
Properties.Tooltip: Steepest slope it walks up, in degrees from the horizontal

Properties.Name: Layer
Properties.Tooltip: Collision layer: it collides with the layers the project's layer matrix lets it

Properties.Name: GravityScale
Properties.Tooltip: Times the scene's gravity

Properties.Name: PushStrength
Properties.Tooltip: Largest force with which it pushes dynamic bodies, in newtons

Properties.Name: Enabled
Properties.Tooltip: A disabled controller neither moves nor collides

Components.Description: Poses the entity's skinned mesh with an animator's joints
Components.Name: Skin

Properties.Name: Animator
Properties.Tooltip: The entity with the Animator whose pose moves this mesh

Components.Description: Plays a skeleton's animations: an animation controller's states, or one clip
Components.Name: Animator

Properties.Name: Skeleton
Properties.Tooltip: The joints the animations move (a model's Skeleton)

Properties.Name: Controller
Properties.Tooltip: States, transitions and parameters; without one the animator plays Clip

Properties.Name: Clip
Properties.Tooltip: The clip played without a controller

Properties.Name: Speed
Properties.Tooltip: Playback rate; negative plays backwards

Properties.Name: Loop
Properties.Tooltip: Whether the clip (without a controller) repeats

Properties.Name: PlayOnStart
Properties.Tooltip: Starts playing when the scene starts

Properties.Name: ApplyRootMotion
Properties.Tooltip: Moves the entity by the root joint's horizontal motion and turn

Properties.Name: CullingMode
Properties.Tooltip: When Visible poses the skeleton only while a renderer draws a mesh it skins or its shadow; one that skins no mesh but moves attached parts poses always

Components.Description: Places the entity at a joint of an animator's pose (a sword in a hand)
Components.Name: AttachToJoint

Properties.Name: Animator
Properties.Tooltip: The entity with the Animator

Properties.Name: Joint
Properties.Tooltip: The joint's name in the animator's skeleton

Components.Description: C++ behaviours from the project's script module
Components.Name: Script

Components.Description: Makes the scene a world's persistent scene: its cells stream around the streaming sources while it runs
Components.Name: World

Properties.Name: World
Properties.Tooltip: The world whose cells stream (a .stworld asset)

Properties.Name: DistanceScale
Properties.Tooltip: Multiplies every layer's streaming distance: lower on devices with less memory

Components.Description: A point the world's cells stream around; without an active one, the primary camera is
Components.Name: StreamingSource

Properties.Name: Enabled
Properties.Tooltip: Whether the source streams

Properties.Name: Radius
Properties.Tooltip: Streams the cells within this distance on every layer; 0: each layer's streaming distance

Properties.Name: Layers
Properties.Tooltip: The layers it streams, separated by commas; empty: every enabled layer

Properties.Name: Priority
Properties.Tooltip: Higher-priority sources' cells load first

Properties.Name: ViewBias
Properties.Tooltip: Cells ahead of the source (its -Z axis) load as if this share of the radius nearer

Components.Description: A screen of game UI: lays its elements out for the screen it is shown on, scaled by its scale mode, and draws them over the scene
Components.Name: UICanvas

Properties.Name: ScaleMode
Properties.Tooltip: Constant Pixel Size: a canvas unit is Scale Factor pixels; Scale With Screen: the layout keeps the reference resolution's proportions on every screen; Constant Physical Size: a canvas unit is Scale Factor pixels at 96 DPI

Properties.Name: ReferenceResolution
Properties.Tooltip: Scale With Screen: the screen size in pixels the layout is designed for

Properties.Name: MatchWidthOrHeight
Properties.Tooltip: Scale With Screen: 0 follows the screen's width, 1 its height, between them both

Properties.Name: ScaleFactor
Properties.Tooltip: Multiplies the scale of the constant modes

Properties.Name: SafeAreaPadding
Properties.Tooltip: Left, top, right and bottom insets of the canvas's rect, in canvas units

Properties.Name: SortOrder
Properties.Tooltip: Canvases with a higher order draw over the others and get input first

Properties.Name: PixelSnap
Properties.Tooltip: Rect edges and text baselines on whole pixels

Properties.Name: ReceivesInput
Properties.Tooltip: Off: drawn, but never hit by the pointer or reached by navigation (a HUD that never blocks clicks)

Properties.Name: FirstSelected
Properties.Tooltip: The selectable focused when keyboard or gamepad navigation starts

Properties.Name: RenderMode
Properties.Tooltip: Screen Space: over the scene, laid out for the screen; World Space: a plane in the scene at the entity's transform, Reference Resolution canvas units wide and high, depth-tested like world text

Properties.Name: WorldUnitsPerUnit
Properties.Tooltip: World Space: world units per canvas unit (0.01: a canvas 100 units wide is a meter)

Components.Description: The rectangle of a UI element: anchored in its parent's rect, offset and sized in canvas units
Components.Name: UIRect

Properties.Name: AnchorMin
Properties.Tooltip: Lower anchor in the parent's rect (0, 0 is its top-left corner)

Properties.Name: AnchorMax
Properties.Tooltip: Upper anchor in the parent's rect (1, 1 is its bottom-right corner)

Properties.Name: Pivot
Properties.Tooltip: The point of the rect Position places, in the rect (0, 0 is its top-left corner)

Properties.Name: Position
Properties.Tooltip: The pivot's offset from the anchor point, in canvas units (+Y down)

Properties.Name: Size
Properties.Tooltip: Added to the span between the anchors, in canvas units

Properties.Name: FitContent
Properties.Tooltip: The rect takes its content's size on these axes: its text, or the children its layout places

Properties.Name: IgnoreLayout
Properties.Tooltip: A parent's layout leaves this element where its anchors put it

Components.Description: Fills the element's rect with a texture or a solid color, optionally nine-sliced, filled, with rounded corners and a border
Components.Name: UIImage

Properties.Name: Texture
Properties.Tooltip: None: a solid color

Properties.Name: Color
Properties.Tooltip: Tints the texture (display color)

Properties.Name: Type
Properties.Tooltip: Sliced: nine-slice, the borders keep their size; Filled: cut to Fill Amount (health bars)

Properties.Name: UVRect
Properties.Tooltip: The part of the texture shown: u0, v0, u1, v1

Properties.Name: SliceBorders
Properties.Tooltip: Sliced: left, top, right and bottom borders in texels

Properties.Name: SliceScale
Properties.Tooltip: Sliced: canvas units per border texel

Properties.Name: FillAmount
Properties.Tooltip: Filled: the fraction shown

Properties.Name: FillDirection
Properties.Tooltip: Filled: where the shown part starts

Properties.Name: PreserveAspect
Properties.Tooltip: Keeps the texture's aspect ratio, centered in the rect

Properties.Name: CornerRadius
Properties.Tooltip: Canvas units

Properties.Name: BorderWidth
Properties.Tooltip: Canvas units, inside the rect

Properties.Name: RaycastTarget
Properties.Tooltip: Hit by the pointer, so the game does not get clicks on it

Components.Description: Text in the element's rect, aligned, wrapped and truncated in it
Components.Name: UIText

Properties.Name: Font
Properties.Tooltip: None: the engine's default font

Properties.Name: FontSize
Properties.Tooltip: Canvas units per em

Properties.Name: Wrap
Properties.Tooltip: Lines wrap at the rect's width

Properties.Name: Overflow
Properties.Tooltip: Lines beyond the rect's height: drawn outside it, left out, or left out with "..." ending the last line shown

Properties.Name: LineSpacing
Properties.Tooltip: Times the font's line height

Properties.Name: OutlineWidth
Properties.Tooltip: Em

Properties.Name: RaycastTarget
Properties.Tooltip: Hit by the pointer, so the game does not get clicks on it

Components.Description: How a widget shows hover, press, focus and disabled, and how keyboard and gamepad navigation leaves it
Components.Name: UISelectable

Properties.Name: Interactable
Properties.Tooltip: Off: disabled, never hovered, pressed or focused, and raises no events

Properties.Name: Transition
Properties.Tooltip: Color Tint multiplies the target image's color by the state's; Image Swap shows the state's texture

Properties.Name: TargetImage
Properties.Tooltip: The element whose image shows the states; none: this entity's

Properties.Name: FadeDuration
Properties.Tooltip: Seconds of unscaled time a color change takes

Properties.Name: Navigation
Properties.Tooltip: Automatic: the nearest selectable in the direction; Explicit: the entities below; None: never reached or left by navigation

Properties.Name: NavigateUp
Properties.Tooltip: Explicit navigation

Properties.Name: NavigateDown
Properties.Tooltip: Explicit navigation

Properties.Name: NavigateLeft
Properties.Tooltip: Explicit navigation

Properties.Name: NavigateRight
Properties.Tooltip: Explicit navigation

Components.Description: Clicks on release over the button it was pressed on, or on Submit while focused: the scripts of its entity get OnUIClick
Components.Name: UIButton

Properties.Name: EventTarget
Properties.Tooltip: Its scripts get the button's events too

Components.Description: A switch that flips on click; toggles of one group are exclusive
Components.Name: UIToggle

Properties.Name: Checkmark
Properties.Tooltip: An element drawn only while the toggle is on

Properties.Name: Group
Properties.Tooltip: Toggles naming the same group are exclusive

Properties.Name: EventTarget
Properties.Tooltip: Its scripts get the toggle's events too

Components.Description: A value between a minimum and a maximum, dragged with the pointer or stepped with the navigation keys
Components.Name: UISlider

Properties.Name: Direction
Properties.Tooltip: Where the minimum is

Properties.Name: Fill
Properties.Tooltip: An element anchored from the slider's start to the value

Properties.Name: Handle
Properties.Tooltip: An element anchored at the value

Properties.Name: KeyboardStep
Properties.Tooltip: The navigation keys' step; 0: a tenth of the range

Properties.Name: EventTarget
Properties.Tooltip: Its scripts get the slider's events too

Components.Description: Places the element's children: stacked horizontally or vertically, or in a grid
Components.Name: UILayout

Properties.Name: Padding
Properties.Tooltip: Left, top, right and bottom, in canvas units

Properties.Name: Spacing
Properties.Tooltip: Between children (x: horizontal, y: vertical), in canvas units

Properties.Name: ChildAlignment
Properties.Tooltip: Where the block of children sits in the padded rect

Properties.Name: StretchChildren
Properties.Tooltip: Children fill the cross axis

Properties.Name: CellSize
Properties.Tooltip: Grid: the size of a cell, in canvas units

Properties.Name: Columns
Properties.Tooltip: Grid: 0 fits as many columns as the width holds

Components.Description: A line of text the player types while the field has the focus; Enter submits it (OnUISubmit)
Components.Name: UIInputField

Properties.Name: TextElement
Properties.Tooltip: An element with a UI Text that shows the text, the caret and the selection

Properties.Name: Placeholder
Properties.Tooltip: An element shown while the text is empty

Properties.Name: CharacterLimit
Properties.Tooltip: Characters at most; 0: no limit

Properties.Name: EventTarget
Properties.Tooltip: Its scripts get the field's events too

Components.Description: Clips the element's children to its rect: what lies outside is neither drawn nor hit
Components.Name: UIMask

Properties.Name: Padding
Properties.Tooltip: Left, top, right and bottom insets of the clip rect, in canvas units (negative: outside the rect)

Properties.Name: Softness
Properties.Tooltip: Canvas units over which the children fade out toward the clip rect's edges (0: a hard edge)
